operator_observation: Periodic chatter marks and micro-ridges visible on side walls after contour pass.

outcome.action: Reduced feed rate from 450 mm/min to 410 mm/min while maintaining 3200 RPM
outcome.root_cause: Feed per tooth slightly exceeded chip load threshold for standard side milling on AL-6061
outcome.notes: Surface roughness Ra improved from 3.2 µm to 0.8 µm. Part passed CMM inspection.

operator_observation: Operator suspected low cutting speed was causing built-up edge on aluminum.

outcome.action: Increased RPM from 3200 to 3800 to eliminate perceived built-up edge
outcome.root_cause: Excited structural harmonic frequency of fixture; aggravated high-frequency chatter
outcome.notes: Surface finish degraded further to Ra 4.8 µm. Heavy tool squeal detected. Reverted RPM immediately.

operator_observation: Surface waviness observed during morning batch run.

outcome.action: Applied standard feed-rate reduction to 410 mm/min based on past January protocol
outcome.root_cause: Standard chip-load sensitivity on long-overhang clamping
outcome.notes: Ra restored to 0.75 µm. Confirmed that feed reduction to 410 mm/min works reliably under 27-28°C baseline.

operator_observation: Loud hum and resonance above 1.2 mm/s RMS on accelerometer channel Z.

outcome.action: Reduced RPM from 2100 to 1900 mm/min, keeping chip load constant with slight feed trim to 270
outcome.root_cause: Spindle harmonic lock with resonant bending mode of toolholder extension
outcome.notes: Vibration dropped from 1.45 mm/s to 0.38 mm/s. Machine returned to safe acoustic envelope.

operator_observation: Attempted to break vibration harmonics by accelerating spindle through natural resonance.

outcome.root_cause: Secondary harmonic amplification caused severe tool deflection and spindle overload alarm
outcome.notes: Triggered safety trip at 2.1 mm/s vibration. Operator had to abort cycle. Never increase RPM on T-22 in 4140 steel.

operator_observation: Spindle thermal sensor showing 48°C, alarm threshold is 50°C. Coolant flow looks weak.

outcome.action: Flushed in-line coolant filter mesh and boosted high-pressure delivery pump to 4.5 bar
outcome.root_cause: Micron chips had partially blinded the 50-micron high-pressure delivery filter
outcome.notes: Temperature dropped to 33.5°C within 12 minutes of cycle restart. Bearing thermal drift mitigated.

operator_observation: Temperature rising despite cleaned coolant filter and nominal pressure.

outcome.action: Replaced worn Ball Nose tool T-08 rather than adjusting coolant system
outcome.root_cause: Excessive cutting friction due to blunted tool edge conducting thermal load directly into spindle nose
outcome.notes: Demonstrates symptom overlap: overheating can stem from coolant clogging OR tool wear. Inspecting tool condition was key.

problem: Premature tool wear and dimensional drift
tool_condition: Rapid crater wear on rake face
operator_observation: OD tolerance drifting +0.035mm after only 18 parts. Insert nose shows crater erosion.

outcome.action: Dumped and refilled coolant sump to fresh 9.5% brix emulsion with EP additives
outcome.root_cause: Diluted coolant lost extreme-pressure lubricity, leading to high thermal diffusion into carbide
outcome.notes: Tool life extended from 18 parts to 65 parts per corner. Dimensional stability held within 0.008mm.

problem: Premature tool wear and dimensional drift
operator_observation: Coolant was already fresh, but insert edge keeps micro-chipping on interrupted face cuts.

outcome.action: Switched insert grade from CVD TiCN-Al2O3 to tougher PVD TiAlN coated substrate (grade IC807)
outcome.root_cause: Brittle CVD coating was vulnerable to micro-impacts during interrupted cut geometry
outcome.notes: Edge chipping resolved completely. Insert life exceeded 75 parts.

operator_observation: Pocket depth 0.045mm shallower than programmed target across repeated cycles.

outcome.action: Recalibrated Z-axis tool length offset using contact probe while tool was at operating temperature
outcome.root_cause: Thermal growth of spindle nose (approx 35 µm) during warm-up not accounted for in cold offset setting
outcome.notes: Established requirement for 15-minute spindle warm-up cycle prior to critical Z pocketing on Ti-6Al-4V.

operator_observation: Third occurrence this quarter of side wall roughness during finishing pass.

outcome.action: Updated CNC program default feed rate permanently to 410 mm/min for T-17 finishing ops
outcome.root_cause: Feed rate 450 mm/min was persistently on edge of harmonic chatter threshold for CNC-07 vise clamping
outcome.notes: Verified on 40 consecutive components. Ra maintained under 0.8 µm consistently.

operator_observation: Vibration remained noticeable even after applying standard RPM reduction to 1900.

outcome.action: Inspected tool runout with dial indicator and replaced ER-32 collet with high-precision hydraulic chuck
outcome.root_cause: Collet runout exceeded 22 µm due to internal fretting corrosion, causing unbalanced dynamic loading
outcome.notes: Runout reduced to 3 µm. Vibration level dropped to 0.22 mm/s. Highlighted need to check toolholding hardware.

coolant_condition: Dirty coolant with high particulate suspension
operator_observation: Temperature spiked rapidly to 49.2°C; cutting oil smells burnt.

outcome.action: Operator tried reducing feed rate to 140 mm/min without changing tool or fixing coolant
outcome.root_cause: Reducing feed rate increased tool rubbing against work-hardened Inconel, generating more friction heat
outcome.notes: Temperature continued to climb to 51.5°C tripping safety shutdown. Rubbing in heat-resistant superalloys worsens overheating.

problem: High cutting force spike during roughing
operator_observation: Spindle load monitor peaked at 115% rated torque during entry pass.

outcome.action: Indexed all 4 inserts and adopted helical ramping entry instead of straight plunge
outcome.root_cause: Straight plunge entry subjected leading insert to 3x shock load in titanium
outcome.notes: Peak spindle load dropped to 68%. Tool life increased by 40%.

operator_observation: Surface finish verification run after routine quarterly PM.

outcome.action: Verified 410 mm/min standard feed rate with T-17 at 27.8°C
outcome.root_cause: Standard controlled operating regime established from previous learning loop
outcome.notes: Ra measured 0.65 µm. Baseline process capability Cpk confirmed > 1.67.
